import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    array = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    cost = [-1] * n
    balance = 0
    for i in range(n):
        balance += 1 if array[i] % 2 == 0 else -1
        if balance == 0 and i != n - 1:
            cost[i] = abs(array[i + 1] - array[i])

    cost.sort()
    total = 0
    cut = 0
    for value in cost:
        if value == -1:
            continue
        total += value
        if total > b:
            break
        cut += 1

    print(cut)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
